title: Electronic Engine Controls — System Operation
introduction: An engine has several jobs to coordinate: breathing, metering fuel and controlling combustion. I use the operating description as the conductor’s score for understanding how those jobs fit together. This entry points you to that explanation in the required manual; it contains no component descriptions or diagnostic tests.

items.name: Powertrain control and emissions manual
items.detail: Have the manual named below available to read the detailed operating description.

edits.text: Use this entry to locate the engine-control operating description.
edits.why: This page serves as a reference gateway, so its useful outcome is directing the reader to the detailed explanation.

edits.text: For the detailed operating description, refer to the Powertrain Control/Emissions Diagnosis (PC/ED) Manual, Section 1, Description and Operation.
edits.why: The named manual section is the required next reference for understanding system operation. This entry does not supply enough information to explain individual control strategies or conduct a diagnostic test.
